    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">XXL-Job 全链路监控看板和告警方案：从 Pod 健康到任务尾延迟的可观测闭环</span>

<li>
<h1>项目说明</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_d2c49dc0-6271-42c2-8622-6a3ae35ae8dc" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_d2c49dc0-6271-42c2-8622-6a3ae35ae8dc" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_d2c49dc0-6271-42c2-8622-6a3ae35ae8dc" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre># XXL-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Job Exporter 监控

通过 [sql_exporter](https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/burningalchemist/sql_exporter) 直查 XXL-Job RDS 数据库，将任务成功/失败数暴露为 Prometheus 指标，配合 Grafana 看板展示多环境 XXL-Job 运行状态。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
## 目录结构

```
xxljob</span>-exporter/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── grafana</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dashboard.json       # Grafana 看板（导入一次，所有环境共用）
├── qa</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   ├── xxljob</span>-sql-exporter.yaml # QA 环境：ConfigMap + Deployment + Service +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ServiceMonitor
│   └── argocd</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app.yaml          # QA 环境 ArgoCD Application
├── uat</span>/                         # UAT 环境（参考 qa/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 新建）
├── prod</span>/                        # Prod 环境（参考 qa/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 新建）
└── README.md
```

## 架构与映射原理

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  用户在 Grafana 选择: xxljob_cluster </span>= xxljob-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">qa            │
│                         ↓                                   │
│  隐藏变量自动推导:                                           │
│  $k8s_cluster </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> label_values(                               │
│    up{xxljob_cluster</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxljob-qa</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}, cluster                  │
│  )  →  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ltp-nonprod-eks</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                                    │
│                         ↓                                   │
│  sql</span>-exporter 指标: xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxljob-qa</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">              │
│  kube</span>-state-metrics 指标: cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ltp-nonprod-eks</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</span>**映射关系不在 dashboard 里维护**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，由两处配置自动决定：

</span>| 配置项 | 位置 | 作用 |
|--------|------|------|
| `externalLabels.cluster` | 各集群 Prometheus values.yaml | 决定 `$k8s_cluster` 的值 |
| ServiceMonitor `xxljob_cluster` relabeling | 各环境 `xxljob-sql-exporter.yaml` | 决定 `$xxljob_cluster` 的值 |

**当前环境映射：**

| xxljob_cluster | k8s cluster | 说明 |
|----------------|-------------|------|
| xxljob-qa | ltp-nonprod-eks | QA 环境 |
| xxljob-prod | ltp-eks-prod | 生产环境 |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 新增环境（以 UAT 为例）

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> — 复制 QA 配置

```bash
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cp</span> -r xxljob-exporter/qa xxljob-exporter/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uat
```

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> — 修改 `uat/xxljob-sql-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">exporter.yaml`

需要修改以下字段：

```yaml
# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. target — RDS 地址改为 UAT 的
target:
  data_source_name: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mysql://root:${DB_PASSWORD}@&lt;uat-rds-endpoint&gt;:3306/xxl_job?...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. ServiceMonitor relabelings — 改为 UAT 的标识
relabelings:
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> targetLabel: xxljob_cluster
    replacement: xxljob</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uat          # ← 改这里，全局唯一
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> targetLabel: xxljob_dns
    replacement: https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">uat-xxljob.icbc.com/xxl-job-admin/  # ← 改这里</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">```

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> — 修改 `uat/argocd-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app.yaml`

```yaml
metadata:
  name: xxljob</span>-exporter-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uat          # ← 改名

spec:
  source:
    path: xxljob</span>-exporter/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">uat        # ← 改路径
  destination:
    server: https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;uat-eks-api-endpoint&gt;   # ← UAT 集群的 API server</span>
    namespace: xxl-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">job
```

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> — 创建 DB Secret

在 UAT 集群执行（Secret 不纳入 Git）：

```bash
kubectl create secret generic xxljob</span>-db-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">secret \
  </span>--from-literal=db-password=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;uat-db-password&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
  </span>-n xxl-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">job \
  </span>--context &lt;uat-kubeconfig-context&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> — 提交并部署

```bash
git add xxljob</span>-exporter/uat/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
git commit </span>-m <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">feat: add xxljob exporter for uat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
git push

# 在 UAT 集群 ArgoCD 中接管
kubectl apply </span>-f xxljob-exporter/uat/argocd-app.yaml -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">n argocd
```

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> — 确认映射生效

部署后约 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分钟，在 Prometheus 中验证：

```promql
up{xxljob_cluster</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxljob-uat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

返回结果中应同时包含 `cluster</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ltp-uat-eks</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`（或对应集群名）。

Grafana 看板下拉菜单刷新后自动出现 `xxljob</span>-uat` 选项，**无需修改 dashboard**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。

## Grafana 看板导入

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Grafana → Dashboards → Import
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 上传 `grafana-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dashboard.json`
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 选择对应的 Prometheus datasource
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 导入后所有环境共用此看板

看板变量说明：

</span>| 变量 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `$datasource` | 数据源 | Prometheus 实例 |
| `$xxljob_cluster` | 下拉选择 | XXL-Job 集群标识，用户可见 |
| `$k8s_cluster` | 隐藏 | 自动从 `up` 指标映射出 K8s 集群名，用于过滤 kube 指标 |
| `$xxljob_dns` | 下拉选择 | 管理后台 URL，随 `$xxljob_cluster` 联动 |
| `$namespace` | 下拉选择 | 随 `$k8s_cluster` 过滤后的命名空间 |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 指标说明

</span>| 指标名 | 类型 | 说明 | 采集周期 |
|--------|------|------|----------|
| `xxl_job_task_result_success_count` | gauge | 近 1h 各业务组成功数 | 120s |
| `xxl_job_task_result_fail_count` | gauge | 近 1h 各业务组失败数 | 120s |
| `xxl_job_task_result_running_count` | gauge | 近 1h 各业务组运行中数 | 120s |
| `xxl_job_task_daily_success_count` | gauge | 近 24h 各 Job 成功数 | 300s |
| `xxl_job_task_daily_fail_count` | gauge | 近 24h 各 Job 失败数 | 300s |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 故障排查

</span>**下拉菜单集群/管理后台为空**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

```promql
# 验证 up 指标是否携带 xxljob_cluster 标签
up{xxljob_cluster</span>=~<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.+</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
```

若无结果，检查：
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. sql-exporter pod 是否运行：`kubectl get pods -n xxl-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">job`
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Prometheus Targets 页面是否能发现该 exporter
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. ServiceMonitor namespace 与 Prometheus 是否在同一集群

</span>**Pod 数量显示不正确（偏多）**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

多个集群的 kube</span>-state-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">metrics 指标汇聚到同一 Prometheus 时会出现重复计数。
看板已通过 `cluster</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>` +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `max by (namespace, pod)` 处理去重，
若仍有问题确认 `$k8s_cluster` 变量是否正确解析。

</span>**SQL 查询无数据**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

确认 RDS Security Group 允许 EKS Node → </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3306</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，并验证 DB 密码 Secret 存在：

```bash
kubectl get secret xxljob</span>-db-secret -n xxl-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">job
```</span></pre>
</div>

<h1>功能说明</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 服务健康监控
Pod 状态：UP</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">DOWN 状态指示，一眼判断 Admin 是否存活
重启次数（1h）：阈值告警（</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>→绿，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>→黄，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">→红），快速发现 CrashLoop
Pod 运行时长：判断是否近期被重启过
Ready Pod 数量：多副本场景下反映可用实例数
CPU </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Memory Gauge：当前资源占用与上限对比，超限风险可视
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 资源使用趋势
CPU 使用量：实际使用 vs Limit 两条线叠加，资源争抢一目了然
内存使用量：同上，OOM 风险监控
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. 任务总览（1h +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 24h 双时间窗口）
整体成功率 Gauge：近 1h 和近 24h 各一个，短期波动 </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 长期趋势对比
成功</span>/失败/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">运行中任务数：核心 KPI 指标卡
总执行数 </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 整体失败率：吞吐量与质量双视角
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 任务执行趋势
成功数（绿）、失败数（红）、运行中 三条曲线，每分钟采样
失败曲线有 hideSeriesFrom 配置，默认隐藏失败数，聚焦成功趋势时仍可切换查看
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 任务执行耗时分位数 ✨ 新增
P95 </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> P99 执行耗时：反映长尾任务的执行时长分布
区分</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功任务的耗时分布</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>与<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">整体延迟水位</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，支撑慢任务排查
与成功</span>/失败计数互补，从<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">量</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>（做了多少）扩展到<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">质</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（做得多慢）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 业务组详情
各业务组失败趋势：仅展示 </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 的失败组，过滤噪音
业务组明细表：成功数</span>/失败数/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">成功率三列，按失败数排序，带渐变背景色，快速定位最差业务组
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 24h Job 明细 ✨ 优化
粒度细化到 job_name 级别（业务组 </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 任务名称）
Top N 限制 </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分页：大集群下 job_name 众多时，只展示最值得关注的部分（如失败数 Top N 或耗时 Top N），避免行数爆炸、表格卡顿
按失败数排序，成功率渐变着色
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 模板变量（联动筛选）
变量    说明
datasource    数据源选择
xxljob_cluster    XXL</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Job 集群（主变量）
k8s_cluster    自动联动 K8s 集群（hide</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，隐藏不可见）
xxljob_dns    管理后台地址，可一键跳转
namespace    命名空间
整体刷新 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 分钟，时间默认近 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> 小时</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<h1>项目实现</h1>
<h1 class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_eb7b0d23-1148-42c9-871b-d69d8e758b87" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_eb7b0d23-1148-42c9-871b-d69d8e758b87" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none"></h1>
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_eb7b0d23-1148-42c9-871b-d69d8e758b87" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre># =============================================================================<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# XXL</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Job SQL Exporter — QA 环境
# </span>=============================================================================<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 通过直查 RDS xxl_job_log 表，将任务成功</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">失败数暴露为 Prometheus 指标
#
# 依赖：
#   </span>- xxl-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">job namespace 已存在（或 ArgoCD syncOptions 开启 CreateNamespace）
#   </span>- RDS Security Group 允许 EKS Node → <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3306</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#   </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Prometheus Operator 已部署（ServiceMonitor CRD 存在）
#
# Secret 说明：
#   DB 密码当前存于 xxljob</span>-db-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">secret，请勿将真实密码提交 Git。
#   生产环境建议替换为 SealedSecret 或 External Secrets Operator (AWS Secrets Manager)。
#
# 更新 SQL 查询：
#   修改下方 ConfigMap data.config.yml 中的 query 字段，ArgoCD Sync 后自动生效。
# </span>=============================================================================<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# Secret xxljob</span>-db-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">secret 通过 kubectl create secret 手动创建，不纳入 Git 管理。
# kubectl create secret generic xxljob</span>-db-secret --from-literal=db-password=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> -n xxl-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">job

# </span>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# ConfigMap — sql_exporter 查询配置
# </span>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: xxljob</span>-sql-exporter-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config
  namespace: monitoring
data:
  config.yml: </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    global:
      scrape_timeout: 50s
      scrape_timeout_offset: 500ms
      max_connections: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      max_idle_connections: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    target:
      data_source_name: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mysql://xxl-job:${DB_PASSWORD}@hostname:3306/xxl_job?parseTime=true&amp;loc=UTC</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      collectors: [xxl_job_metrics_1h, xxl_job_metrics_24h, xxl_job_duration_1h]

    collectors:
      # 近 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 小时：按业务组统计，每 60s 采集一次
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> collector_name: xxl_job_metrics_1h
        min_interval: 120s
        metrics:
          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_result_success_count
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job success count by group (last 1h)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name]
            values: [success_count]
            query_ref: task_result_1h

          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_result_fail_count
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job fail count by group (last 1h)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name]
            values: [fail_count]
            query_ref: task_result_1h

          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_result_running_count
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job running count by group (last 1h)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name]
            values: [running_count]
            query_ref: task_result_1h

        queries:
          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> query_name: task_result_1h
            query: </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              SELECT
                COALESCE(g.title, CAST(l.job_group AS CHAR)) AS job_group_name,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN l.handle_code </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span> THEN <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> END)                        AS success_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN l.handle_code IN (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">500</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">502</span>) THEN <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> END)                AS fail_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN l.handle_code </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> AND l.trigger_code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span> THEN <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> END) AS running_count
              FROM xxl_job_log l
              LEFT JOIN xxl_job_group g ON l.job_group </span>= g.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              WHERE l.trigger_time </span>&gt;= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HOUR)
              GROUP BY l.job_group, g.title

      # 近 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 小时：按具体 Job 统计，每 5m 采集一次降低全表扫描压力
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> collector_name: xxl_job_metrics_24h
        min_interval: 300s
        metrics:
          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_daily_success_count
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job success count per job (last 24h)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name, job_name]
            values: [success_count]
            query_ref: task_daily_24h

          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_daily_fail_count
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job fail count per job (last 24h)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name, job_name]
            values: [fail_count]
            query_ref: task_daily_24h

        queries:
          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> query_name: task_daily_24h
            query: </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              SELECT
                COALESCE(g.title, CAST(l.job_group AS CHAR)) AS job_group_name,
                COALESCE(i.job_desc, CAST(l.job_id AS CHAR)) AS job_name,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN l.handle_code </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span> THEN <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> END)         AS success_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN l.handle_code IN (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">500</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">502</span>) THEN <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> END) AS fail_count
              FROM xxl_job_log l
              LEFT JOIN xxl_job_group g ON l.job_group </span>= g.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              LEFT JOIN xxl_job_info  i ON l.job_id   </span>= i.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              WHERE l.trigger_time </span>&gt;= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HOUR)
              GROUP BY l.job_group, g.title, l.job_id, i.job_desc
              ORDER BY fail_count DESC, success_count DESC
              LIMIT </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

      # 执行耗时：avg</span>/max/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">慢任务数，每 2m 采集，用于排查慢任务
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> collector_name: xxl_job_duration_1h
        min_interval: 120s
        metrics:
          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_avg_duration_seconds
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job avg execution duration per group (last 1h, success only)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name]
            values: [avg_duration_s]
            query_ref: duration_1h

          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_max_duration_seconds
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job max execution duration per group (last 1h, success only)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name]
            values: [max_duration_s]
            query_ref: duration_1h

          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> metric_name: xxl_job_task_slow_count
            type: gauge
            help: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">XXL-Job tasks exceeding 60s per group (last 1h)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            key_labels: [job_group_name]
            values: [slow_gt60s]
            query_ref: duration_1h

        queries:
          </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> query_name: duration_1h
            query: </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              SELECT
                COALESCE(g.title, CAST(l.job_group AS CHAR)) AS job_group_name,
                ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, l.trigger_time, l.handle_time)), </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) AS avg_duration_s,
                MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, l.trigger_time, l.handle_time))           AS max_duration_s,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, l.trigger_time, l.handle_time) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span> THEN <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> ELSE <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> END) AS slow_gt60s
              FROM xxl_job_log l
              LEFT JOIN xxl_job_group g ON l.job_group </span>= g.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
              WHERE l.trigger_time </span>&gt;= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HOUR)
                AND l.handle_code </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                AND l.handle_time IS NOT NULL
                AND l.trigger_time IS NOT NULL
              GROUP BY l.job_group, g.title

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

        factor: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    syncOptions:

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">annotations</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
      {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">builtIn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">datasource</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">grafana</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-- Grafana --</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        },

<h1 class="cnblogs_code"><span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">xxljob-dashboard.json</span></h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<h1>项目价值</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">维度    价值说明
故障发现    Pod 状态 </span>+ 重启次数 + 运行时长三件套，可在 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 分钟刷新周期内捕捉到服务异常/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">重启事件，缩短 MTTD（平均发现时间）
根因定位    从</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">整体失败率 → 业务组失败趋势 → 业务组明细 → 24h Job 明细</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">逐层下钻，从集群级定位到具体 job_name，缩短 MTTI（定位时间）
慢任务定位 ✨ 新增    P95</span>/P99 耗时让<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">慢任务</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>问题可量化——以前只能看到<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功了 N 个</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>，现在能知道<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">最慢的 1% 花了多久</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，支撑性能优化决策（是否拆分任务、是否扩并发、是否优化 SQL）
容量规划    CPU</span>/内存 使用量 vs Limit 叠加曲线，判断是否需要扩容或调限，避免资源浪费与 OOM/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Throttling
SLA 度量    1h </span>+ 24h 双成功率 Gauge，分别覆盖<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">实时健康度</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>和<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">SLA 达标度</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">；P99 耗时可作为延迟 SLA 的客观依据
大集群可扩展性 ✨ 优化    24h 明细表加 Top N </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分页后，job_name 再多也不会让看板卡死或信息过载，看板在多团队、多业务线的大集群下仍可用
多集群复用    通过变量模板化，一套看板可覆盖多个 XXL</span>-Job 集群 /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> K8s 集群，无需重复建板，运维成本低
一键运营闭环    xxljob_dns 变量直通管理后台，发现失败</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">慢任务后可立即跳转处理，闭环更快
噪音过滤    失败趋势只显示 </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> 的组、明细表默认按失败数降序、24h 表 Top N，三层过滤让运维聚焦<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">有问题</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>的部分</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold mt-6 mb-3">XXL-Job 监控看板 — P0/P1/P2 三级告警方案</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_ceabfc93-6555-4ed1-ad88-53950ed9d027" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_ceabfc93-6555-4ed1-ad88-53950ed9d027" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_ceabfc93-6555-4ed1-ad88-53950ed9d027" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre># XXL-Job 监控看板 — P0/P1/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">P2 三级告警方案

</span>&gt; 适用看板：XXL-Job 监控看板（`xxljob-monitor-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1`）
</span>&gt; 覆盖指标：Pod 健康、资源使用、任务成功率/失败率、P95/P99 耗时、业务组/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Job 维度明细
</span>&gt; 生成时间：<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">07</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>

---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 一、分级原则

</span>| 级别 | 含义 | 响应时效 | 通知方式 | 触发场景 |
|------|------|---------|---------|---------|
| **P0 Critical** | 服务不可用/严重故障 | 立即（分钟级） | 电话 + 短信 + IM | 全量 Pod DOWN、大面积任务失败、即将 OOM |
| **P1 Warning** | 性能下降/局部异常 | 工作时间内尽快 | IM 群 @值班 | 失败率飙升、P99 异常、资源吃紧 |
| **P2 Info** | 趋势预警/容量告警 | 当日处理 | IM 群通知 | SLA 边缘、渐进性变慢、容量接近上限 |

---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 二、P0 — Critical（立即响应）

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Admin Pod DOWN
```promql
max(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, pod=~<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin.*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, condition=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>}) == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`== <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`（无 Ready Pod）
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 2m`（避免短暂抖动）
</span>- **说明**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：Admin 服务完全不可用，调度中枢宕机，所有任务调度停摆

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Pod 频繁重启（CrashLoop）
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(max by (namespace, pod, container) (
  increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[1h])
)) </span>&gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`≥ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 次/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">1h`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 0m`（立即触发）
</span>- **说明**：<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> 小时内重启 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 次以上，大概率 CrashLoopBackOff，需立即介入

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>. Ready Pod 数量为 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```promql
count(max by (namespace, pod) (
  kube_pod_status_ready{namespace</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, pod=~<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin.*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, condition=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>} == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)) </span>== <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`== <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 2m`
</span>- **说明**：多副本全挂，与 P0-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> 互补，更明确表达<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无可用实例</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 整体任务成功率断崖式下跌（1h）
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_result_success_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clamp_min(
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_result_success_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
    </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_result_fail_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ) </span>* <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 5m`
</span>- **说明**：成功率跌破 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 意味着大面积任务失败，业务影响严重

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 内存即将 OOM
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, image!=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span>/ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, resource=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">memory</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>}) &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.9</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Limit`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 3m`
</span>- **说明**：内存占用超 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 上限，距离 OOM Kill 一步之遥

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 三、P1 — Warning（尽快响应）

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 整体任务失败率升高（1h）
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_result_fail_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clamp_min(
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_result_success_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
    </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_result_fail_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ) </span>* <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 10m`
</span>- **说明**：失败率超 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，需排查具体业务组

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. P99 执行耗时异常（慢任务）✨
```promql
histogram_quantile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.99</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(rate(xxl_job_task_duration_seconds_bucket{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[5m])) by (le)
) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">300</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; 300s`（<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分钟，按业务调整）
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 10m`
</span>- **说明**：最慢 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 任务耗时超阈值，可能阻塞调度线程、影响下游

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 内存高水位
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, image!=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span>/ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, resource=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">memory</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>}) &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Limit`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 10m`
</span>- **说明**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：内存压力预警，P0 前置防线

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. CPU 持续高负载
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, image!=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[5m]))
  </span>/ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, resource=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cpu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>}) &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Limit`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 15m`
</span>- **说明**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：CPU 接近 throttle，任务调度可能受影响

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 单业务组失败数突增
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> by (job_group_name) (
  increase(xxl_job_task_result_fail_count{xxljob_cluster</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[15m])
) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span> 次/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">15min`（按业务调整）
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 5m`
</span>- **说明**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：定位到具体业务组，比整体失败率更早发现局部问题

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. Pod 出现重启
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(max by (namespace, pod, container) (
  increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[1h])
)) </span>&gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`≥ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> 次/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">1h`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 0m`
</span>- **说明**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：P0 的前置预警，单次重启也值得看一眼

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 四、P2 — Info（当日处理）

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. SLA 边缘（24h 成功率）
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_daily_success_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clamp_min(
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_daily_success_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
    </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(xxl_job_task_daily_fail_count{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ) </span>* <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 30m`
</span>- **说明**：24h 成功率跌破 SLA 线（<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">），需复盘但不紧急

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">13</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. P95 渐进性变慢（趋势告警）
```promql
histogram_quantile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.95</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(rate(xxl_job_task_duration_seconds_bucket{xxljob_cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[1h])) by (le)
) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 120s`（按业务调整）
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 1h`
</span>- **说明**：长尾任务变慢，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">温水煮青蛙</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">型问题，配合基线对比效果更好

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 容量预警（内存长期高占用）
```promql
avg_over_time(
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, image!=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
    </span>/ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, resource=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">memory</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}) [1h:5m]
) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 持续 1h`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 1h`
</span>- **说明**：长期占用 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>% 以上，提示容量规划，考虑扩容/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">调 Limit

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 单 Job 出现失败（早期发现）
```promql
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> by (job_group_name, job_name) (
  increase(xxl_job_task_result_fail_count{xxljob_cluster</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$xxljob_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[1h])
) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 15m`
</span>- **说明**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：任意 job 出现失败即通知，最细粒度的早期信号

### </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. CPU 长期高占用
```promql
avg_over_time(
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, image!=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}[5m]))
    </span>/ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span>(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, cluster=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$k8s_cluster</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, container=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxl-job-admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, resource=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cpu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}) [1h:5m]
) </span>&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
```
</span>- **阈值**：`&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 持续 1h`
</span>- **持续**：`<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 1h`
</span>- **说明**：容量预警，同 P2-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span>

---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 五、告警配置建议

### 通知路由

</span>| 级别 | 渠道 | 工作时间外 | 升级机制 |
|------|------|-----------|---------|
| P0 | 电话 + 短信 + IM @全体 | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>×<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span> 唤醒 | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> 分钟无 ack → 升级上级 |
| P1 | IM @值班 | 工作时间内 | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span> 分钟无 ack → 升级 |
| P2 | IM 群通知 | 次日处理 | 无升级 |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### 抑制与聚合（避免告警风暴）

</span>- **P0-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> Pod DOWN** 触发时，抑制 P1-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> P2 相关的 Pod 重启告警（同源问题）
</span>- **P0-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span> 大面积失败** 触发时，抑制 P1-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span> / P2-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 的单业务组、单 Job 失败告警
</span>- **P0-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> OOM** 触发时，抑制 P1-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> / P2-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 的内存水位告警
</span>- 同一 `job_group_name` 的告警在 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分钟内聚合为一条

### 阈值校准建议

</span>- P99/P95 耗时阈值（300s/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">120s）需根据实际任务画像调整，建议先跑一周观察分布再定基线
</span>- 失败率/失败数阈值需按业务量级调整：小业务 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span> 次失败是大问题，大业务 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 次可能正常
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 所有阈值上线后建议每季度复盘一次，避免业务规模变化后阈值失效

</span>---<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

## 六、告警全景速查表

</span>| 编号 | 级别 | 告警名称 | 核心指标 | 阈值 | 持续 |
|------|------|---------|---------|------|------|
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> | P0 | Admin Pod DOWN | kube_pod_status_ready | ==<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> | 2m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> | P0 | Pod 频繁重启 | container_status_restarts_total | ≥<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>/1h | 0m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> | P0 | Ready Pod 数量为 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> | kube_pod_status_ready count | ==<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> | 2m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span> | P0 | 任务成功率断崖下跌 | success/total | &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>% | 5m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> | P0 | 内存即将 OOM | mem/Limit | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>% | 3m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> | P1 | 任务失败率升高 | fail/total | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>% | 10m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span> | P1 | P99 耗时异常 | histogram_quantile(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.99</span>) | &gt;300s | 10m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> | P1 | 内存高水位 | mem/Limit | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span>% | 10m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span> | P1 | CPU 持续高负载 | cpu/Limit | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span>% | 15m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span> | P1 | 单业务组失败突增 | increase(fail) by group | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>/15m | 5m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span> | P1 | Pod 出现重启 | container_status_restarts_total | ≥<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>/1h | 0m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span> | P2 | SLA 边缘（24h） | daily success/total | &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95</span>% | 30m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">13</span> | P2 | P95 渐进变慢 | histogram_quantile(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.95</span>) | &gt;120s | 1h |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span> | P2 | 内存长期高占用 | avg_over_time(mem/Limit) | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>% | 1h |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span> | P2 | 单 Job 出现失败 | increase(fail) by job | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> | 15m |
| <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span> | P2 | CPU 长期高占用 | avg_over_time(cpu/Limit) | &gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>% | 1h |

---

*本文档基于 XXL-Job 监控看板（xxljob-monitor-v1）现有指标制定，阈值需结合实际业务画像校准后上线。*</pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">监控指标</span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<h1>待优化说明</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>告警联动：当前是只读看板，建议接 Grafana Alerting，对<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">重启次数≥5</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">失败率&gt;10%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Pod DOWN</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">P99 &gt; 阈值</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">配告警规则
耗时基线对比：P95</span>/P99 单看绝对值意义有限，建议叠加<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">近 7 天同时段均值/基线</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，判断当前是否异常飙升
失败原因维度：若指标带 error_type label，可加失败原因分布饼图，从</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">谁失败了</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>进一步到<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">为什么失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
耗时 vs 失败关联：可做散点图（X</span>=耗时，Y=失败率），找出<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">又慢又爱失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>的高危任务</pre>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
